WITH sex_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(e.ID) as exam_count,
    COUNT(e.ID) * 100.0 / 806 as share_pct
  FROM Patient p 
  LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT 
  SEX as sex_group,
  exam_count,
  share_pct,
  NULL as avg_distance_above_mean
FROM sex_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'ABOVE-AVERAGE SEXES' as sex_group,
  SUM(exam_count) as exam_count,
  AVG(share_pct) as share_pct,
  AVG(exam_count - 23.333333) as avg_distance_above_mean
FROM sex_stats
WHERE exam_count > 23.333333
